product.title: Voted #1 on Maui. VIP, Private Road to Hana backstage pass tour

description.text: Explore Maui on this private VIP Backstage Pass Experience that gets farther off the beaten path than typical organized tours. Organized tours are usually helpful for getting oriented, but they hardly ever truly get off the beaten path. Stops include Kahului, Road to Hana, Waterfall Swim Spot, Hana Coast, Black Sand Beach. This private VIP Backstage Pass Experience offers the chance to choose your own itinerary for day-long trips to Maui's most off-the-beaten-path spots, or to sit back and relax and let your guides do all the work and planning. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
